rationale: Late-stage batch culture (36/48 h). Nitrogen is limiting; amino acid fermentation via Stickland pathways yields acetate and propionate. Uptake of 7.5 mmol amino acids/gDW/h (mix of 3–5 C atoms, 1 N each) provides 30 mmol C and 7.5 mmol N. Growth at 0.38/h consumes 16 mmol C and 3.8 mmol N; remainder fermented to acetate (3.5), propionate (2.5), CO₂ (1.2), and ammonia (2.0) from deamination. Mass balanced; realistic for Bacteroides in amino-acid-rich, carbohydrate-poor anaerobic conditions.
